<p>Applies the transformations described by <span class="doxyComputerOutput">Config</span> to <span class="doxyComputerOutput">In</span> and writes the result into <span class="doxyComputerOutput">Out</span>.</p>


<p>The function executeObjcopyOnBinary does the dispatch based on the format of the input binary (<a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/namespaces/llvm/elf">ELF</a>, <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/namespaces/llvm/macho">MachO</a> or <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/namespaces/llvm/coff">COFF</a>).</p>
